description: This file implements an alerting integration with PagerDuty for monitoring high failure rates and hanging requests in the Litellm project. It defines the PagerDutyAlerting class which extends SlackAlerting, adding specialized logic to track failure and hanging events, determine if thresholds are crossed, and send alerts to PagerDuty via their API.

classes.name: PagerDutyAlerting
classes.description: A class that extends SlackAlerting to implement PagerDuty-specific alerting for failure and hanging request thresholds, including logic for threshold monitoring, event logging, and alert dispatching.

methods.name: __init__( self, alerting_args: Optional[Union[AlertingConfig, dict]] = None, **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the PagerDutyAlerting instance, reading configuration from arguments and environment variables, setting thresholds, and initializing event logs.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Records a failure event and triggers an alert if the failure threshold is exceeded within the configured window.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook to monitor for hanging requests, initiating background tasks to detect hung requests.

methods.name: hanging_response_handler( self, request_data: Optional[dict], user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth )
methods.description: Checks if a request has hung by waiting for the threshold duration, then logs a hanging event if not completed by that time.

methods.name: _send_alert_if_thresholds_crossed( self, events: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent], window_seconds: int, threshold: int, alert_prefix: str, )
methods.description: Prunes old events, checks if the event count exceeds the threshold, and sends an alert if necessary.

methods.name: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent] _build_error_summaries( self, events: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent], max_errors: int = 5 )
methods.description: Creates concise summaries of recent events for inclusion in alerts.

methods.name: send_alert_to_pagerduty(self, alert_message: str, custom_details: dict)
methods.description: Dispatches an alert to PagerDuty via their API with the provided message and details.

ctags.signature: ( self, events: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent], window_seconds: int, threshold: int, alert_prefix: str, )

ctags.pattern: /^    async def async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time):$/
